{{Otheruses|unidentified bounty hunter}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' was at one point a would-be [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. They once used a faulty homemade [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] that, when it exploded, blew away the left [[Eye/Legends|eye]] of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Toob Ancher]], left [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]] in need of a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Limb/Legends|leg]] implant, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] seven other people, including the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] themself.<ref name="Journal2">{{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}</ref>
